401.$ref: #/components/responses/INVALID_CREDENTIALS (wrong password OR unknown email — no enumeration)

post.summary:
ADR-0021: bootstrap-admin password login, sibling of OIDC. The
route gates on auth_source='local' so a row SSO has claimed (or a
pure-SSO row) never answers with a password — same 401 code, no
enumeration across auth sources (I-NEW-2).

get.summary:
Open (pre-JWT) capability flags for the login page (R3): the SSO
button renders iff sso_enabled, the local form iff local_enabled.
Only the caller's bound clusters — the binding gate (R3).

200.$ref: #/components/responses/('Cluster events, newest-first (bare list of EventOut items).', None)
#/components/responses/('Every template, built-ins first (bare list, TemplateOut items).', None)

post.summary:
Create a CUSTOM template (built-ins are seeded by migration, not
created here). 422 (rules shape) before 409 (name collision).

put.summary: Update a CUSTOM template only; a built-in → 409.

delete.summary:
Delete a CUSTOM template. Built-in → 409
``BUILTIN_TEMPLATE_PROTECTED``; still referenced by a binding → 409
``CLUSTER_ALREADY_EXISTS`` naming the referencing binding(s).

post.summary:
Resolve the cluster by NAME, then ``services/permission.bind``
(synchronous apply, ADR-0008). The service's errors are already the
stable codes — propagate, don't wrap. The audit row is written by
the service (no double-audit here).

delete.summary:
Resolve the cluster by NAME, then ``services/permission.unbind``
(RoleBinding delete + Role GC). Propagates ``NoBindingsError`` (404)
etc. The audit row is written by the service.

200.$ref: #/components/responses/("The caller's bindings (bare list, BindingOut items); [] when none.", None)

get.summary:
R5: the CALLER's bindings only — never another user's. ``[]``
(not a 404) when the caller has none. No admin gate.

200.$ref: #/components/responses/Every group, local first, name order (bare list, GroupOut items).
#/components/responses/The group + its members (GroupOut with members populated).

post.summary:
Materialize Group + GroupMember rows from users' OIDC claims —
the 4.1 'groups appear after first login' behavior on demand.

Bind a template to the group on a cluster — mirrors the user
bind endpoint, the subject is the group (k8s ``Group`` subject).

200.$ref: #/components/responses/("The caller's kubeconfig as a YAML attachment.", None)

get.summary: R1: the admin sees EVERY user with a binding count.
get.description:
The count is the number of user-management (template-scoped)
``cluster_bindings`` rows — legacy rows auto-bound by cluster
registration (``template=None``, pre user-management) are not
permission bindings and do not count.

post.summary:
4.1 Create User: a Local password account. The sub is
``kubedash:<email>`` so it does not collide with the reserved
``local:`` bootstrap prefix (those rows stay immutable).

patch.summary:
R1: change ``role`` and/or ``status``; audit each change. The
bootstrap ``local:`` admin is immutable (409).

delete.summary:
4.1 row delete. The bootstrap ``local:`` admin and the caller
themselves are refused (409). Bindings and refresh tokens go with
the row.
